capabilities: Set image position with preset values in frontmatter
Position images with precise offset values in units like %, px, em, rem, vh, vw
Rename frontmatter property keys in plugin settings
Apply background-position styles to Bases card cover elements
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.9.10 or later because Bases was introduced in that version. Offers community plugin install plus manual installation steps.
intentEvidence: By default, cover images in Bases card views are centered. This plugin lets you adjust the position per note
motivation: The README says default centering is a problem when the subject of an image is off-center and gets cropped out.
problem: Bases card views center cover images by default, which can crop off-center subjects out of the visible area.
summary: Plugin that controls how cover images are positioned in Bases card views using frontmatter properties per note.
